Ek lender reducing-balance rate bol raha hai aur doosra flat rate — dono ko ek hi unit me badalna hai, tabhi pata chalega kaun sasta hai.
Usi amount par teen, paanch ya saat saal ka term compare kar rahe ho, aur monthly saving ke saamne extra byaaj rupees me dekhna hai.
mistakes: Loan Tenure field me saal likh dena. Ye field mahino me hai — paanch saal ka loan 60 hota hai; 5 daalne par tool paanch mahine ka loan price karta hai aur EMI ₹16,607 ki jagah ₹1,63,618 aa jaati hai.

Flat rate ko annual rate samajh lena. ₹5,00,000 par teen saal ka flat 10% poore amount par day-one se ₹1,50,000 byaaj leta hai — EMI ₹18,056, jo reducing-balance par lagbhag 18% saalana ke barabar hai.

Sirf EMI dekh kar faisla karna aur EMI ke bahar ke charges bhool jaana: 1-2% processing fee aur 2-4% foreclosure charge real cost me ek point se zyada jod dete hain, aur ye na EMI me dikhte hain na is tool ke total me.
emi.hi_intro: ₹8,00,000 ki car loan, 9% par saath mahine — dealership aisa hi ek page ka quote print karke sign karwata hai.
emi.hi_outro: ₹16,607 ki saath instalments milakar ₹9,96,401 bante hain, jisme ₹1,96,401 byaaj hai. Wahi loan chaurasi mahine kar do to EMI ₹12,871 ho jaati hai aur byaaj ₹2,81,186 tak chadhta hai.

epf.what: EPF calculator har mahine aapke PF account mein chup-chaap jo paisa jama hota hai, uska jod lagata hai aur retirement tak woh kitna banega, dikhata hai. Isme do log daalte hain - aap aur aapka employer - aur dono ka paisa interest kamata hai, asli chaunkane wali baat yahi hai. Employee share basic salary ka 12% hota hai, employer utna hi daalta hai, aur balance saal-dar-saal compound hota rehta hai. Jo 25 par join karke 58 par retire hota hai, usne 33 saal paisa daala hai - aur aakhri das saal ka interest akela pehle bees saal ki contribution se zyada hota hai.
epf.formula: Saalana jama = (Employee Monthly PF + Employer Monthly PF) × 12, aur balance EPF rate par saalana compound hota hai. Agar aap aur employer milaakar ₹10,000 mahina daalte ho 8.25% par, toh 30 saal baad corpus takreeban ₹1.42 crore banta hai - jisme sirf ₹36 lakh woh paisa hai jo aapne actually daala. Baaki compound interest hai, aur yahi poora reason hai jaldi shuru karne ka, baad mein zyada daalne ka nahi.
when: Retirement tak PF kitna banega ye jaan-na ho, isse pehle ki aur kahaan bachana hai woh decide karo.
Job switch kar rahe ho aur dekhna hai ki balance chhedne se kitna nuksan hota hai.
PF ko NPS, PPF ya equity SIP se barabar ki taur par compare karna ho.
mistakes: Sirf apni contribution jodna aur employer ka share bhool jaana - isse andar jaane wala paisa takreeban dugna hota hai.
Interest rate fix maan lena. EPF rate har saal review hota hai aur ek dashak se 8% se 8.5% ke beech ghoom raha hai.
EPS split ignore karna - employer ke share ka ek hissa pension mein jaata hai, us PF balance mein nahi jo interest kamata hai.

exitcalc.what: Exit calculator dikhata hai ki company bikne par founder ya angel investor ke haath actually kitna aata hai. News mein jo headline number hota hai woh company ka price hai; jo aapke bank account tak pahunchta hai woh uska aapka equity percentage hai, aur dono bilkul alag hain. Agar aapki ₹4.5 crore ki company mein 18% hai, toh payout ₹81 lakh hai - ₹4.5 crore nahi. Founders saalon valuation par bahas karte hain aur cap table par waqt nahi dete, jabki wahi document us din yeh number tay karta hai.
exitcalc.formula: Payout = Exit Valuation × Your Equity %. ₹25 crore ki sale mein 12% hissa ₹3 crore deta hai. Wahi 12% ₹4.5 crore ki sale mein ₹54 lakh. Asli deals mein do cheezein chup-chaap isse kam karti hain: sale se thoda pehle banaya gaya ESOP pool, aur liquidation preference, jisme investors founders se pehle apna paisa le lete hain. Down-round sale mein preference founder ka payout poora kha sakti hai, chahe equity percentage kagaz par theek dikhe.
when: Acquisition offer aaya hai aur jawab dene se pehle apna number chahiye.
Aur raise karna hai ya abhi bechna hai - dono raaste kitna dete hain ye dekhna hai.
Angel investor ho aur diye hue exit par apne stake ka return nikaalna hai.
mistakes: Company ka sale price apna payout maan lena. Sirf aapka equity percentage aapka hai.
Liquidation preference bhool jaana - ye investors ko pehle milti hai aur chhoti sale mein founders ko kuch nahi bach sakta.
Aaj se exit tak ki dilution ignore karna - har future round aaj ka percentage chhota kar deta hai.

fd.what:
Fixed deposit hi wo product hai jahan advertised rate lagbhag kabhi aapka asli return nahi hota, aur FD calculator yahi farak dikhata hai. Teen cheezein number badalti hain: interest compound hota hai ya nahi, kitni baar hota hai, aur tax kitna kaat leta hai. ₹1,00,000 7% par paanch saal me simple interest par ₹35,000 deta hai, quarterly compound par ₹41,478 - jo zyada banks karte hain - aur 30% slab me TDS limit cross hone par is interest ka lagbhag ₹29,000 bachta hai.

Ye tool jo decision tay karta hai wo ye hai ki lump sum zyada samay ke liye lock karna hai ya nahi, aur jawab headline rate par nahi, post-tax maturity par tika hai. 5 saal ki FD 7% par aur 3 saal ki FD 7% par board par ek jaisi lagti hain; paanch saal me lambi tabhi jeetti hai jab aap 3 saal wali ko maturity par reinvest karo, aur calculator compounded figure dikhata hai taaki is reinvestment risk se compare kar sako. Ye ₹40,000 saalana interest ka mark bhi saamne rakhta hai, kyunki usse cross karte hi high-slab taxpayer ka asli return lagbhag 30% gir jaata hai.
fd.formula: Maturity = principal × (1 + (rate ÷ 100) ÷ frequency)^(frequency × years), aur Interest Earned = Maturity − principal. principal = 1,00,000, rate = 7, frequency = 4, years = 5 par 1,00,000 × (1 + 0.07 ÷ 4)^(4 × 5) = ₹1,41,478, matlab interest ₹41,478 - flat 7% saalana ke ₹35,000 se lagbhag ₹6,478 zyada, kyunki har quarter ka interest khud kamane lagta hai.
when: Lump sum park karna hai aur board ke rate ke bajaye tax ke baad ki asli maturity chahiye.
Lambi aur chhoti tenure compare kar rahe ho aur headline rate nahi, compounded farak chahiye.
Bank FD ko us small-finance bank FD se compare kar rahe ho jo 0.5-1% zyada deta hai, aur dekhna hai ki extra rate tax ke baad bachta hai ya nahi.
mistakes: Advertised rate ko return maan lena. Quarterly compound par maturity simple interest se zyada hoti hai, aur ₹40,000 saalana cross hone par TDS 30% slab wale ka return kaat deta hai.
Compounds per year 1 daal dena jab bank quarterly compound karta hai. 7% FD me frequency = 1 paanch saal me maturity ko hazaron rupaye kam dikhata hai.
Rate ke peeche FD beech me todna aur penalty na dekhna, aksar rate ka 0.5-1% - jo chase kiye ja rahe farak se zyada mehnga padta hai.

franchise.what: Franchise ya store ROI calculator wahi ek sawaal ka jawab deta hai jo kholne ka faisla karta hai: paisa wapas aane mein kitna waqt lagega? Store ki upfront cost - franchise fee, deposit, fit-out, shuru ka stock - badi hoti hai aur zyadatar sunk, aur monthly profit usi ko wapas karta hai. ₹25 lakh mein khulne wala outlet jo ₹1.5 lakh mahina kamata hai, takreeban 17 mahine mein payback karta hai, aur yahi number franchise agreement ki term se compare karna hai.
franchise.formula: Payback Period mahino mein = Starting Investment ÷ Monthly Profit. ₹25 lakh investment, ₹1,50,000 mahina profit: takreeban 17 mahine mein payback. ROI matlab saalana profit divided by investment: ₹18,00,000 ÷ ₹25,00,000 = 72% saalana, jo shaandaar lagta hai jab tak check na karo ki ₹1.5 lakh realistic mahina hai ya best mahina. Agreement ki term se aage payback matlab model kaam nahi karta.
when: Franchise offer evaluate kar rahe ho aur sign karne se pehle payback chahiye.
Do locations compare kar rahe ho jinke rent aur expected sales alag hain.
Doosra outlet kholna hai ya nahi ye decide kar rahe ho.
mistakes: Franchisor ke projected sales use karna, apne conservative figure ki jagah.
Working capital investment se bahar chhod dena. Store ko stock aur cash chahiye isse pehle ki woh kamaye.
Royalty aur marketing fees ignore karna, jo monthly profit se pehle nikal jaati hain.

freelance.what: Freelancer hourly rate calculator nikalta hai ki target income tak pahunchne ke liye aapko per hour kitna charge karna chahiye - aur jawab hamesha freelancers ke pehle anumaan se zyada hota hai. Wajah ye hai ki freelancer ke billable ghante kaam ke ghanton ka ek hissa hi hote hain. Sales, invoicing, seekhna, admin aur projects ke beech ke gaps - sab asli waqt hai jiska koi paisa nahi deta, aur 40-ghante ke week par set kiya rate aisa rate hai jo aapko underpaid chhod dega.
freelance.formula: Hourly Rate = Target Monthly Income ÷ Billable Hours per Month. ₹1,00,000 mahina chahiye, 40 ghante hafta kaam par unme sirf 50% billable, aur 4 hafte: 80 billable ghante. ₹1,00,000 ÷ 80 = ₹1,250 ghanta. ₹800 charge karo toh ₹64,000 kamayenge, chahe kitni bhi mehnat karo. Billable percentage wahi number hai jise freelancers lagataar zyada aankte hain.
when: Client ko quote kar rahe ho aur aisa rate chahiye jo actually pay kare.
Job se freelancing par aa rahe ho aur purani salary match karni hai.
Faisla karna hai ki diye gaye price par project lena worth hai ya nahi.
mistakes: Maanna ki har kaam ka ghanta billable hai. Zyadatar freelancers best case 50% se 70% hi bill karte hain.
Rate competitor ke price se set karna, apni zaroori income se nahi.
Tax bhool jaana, aur ye ki aap khud apna PF, insurance aur chhuttiyan dete ho.

funnel.what: Marketing funnel calculator dikhata hai ki aap har step par kitna dete ho - per click, per lead aur per sale - taaki saaf dikhe ki paisa kahaan leak ho raha hai. Har stage ki apni cost hoti hai, aur har stage ki cost pichhli stage divided by uske conversion rate hoti hai. Zyadatar businesses ad spend aur sales jaante hain aur beech mein kuch nahi, jisse ye pata karna namumkin ho jaata hai ki problem ad hai, landing page hai ya follow-up.
funnel.formula: CPC = Ad Spend ÷ Clicks. CPL = Ad Spend ÷ Leads. CPA = Ad Spend ÷ Conversions. ₹50,000 se 2,500 clicks, 250 leads aur 25 sales: CPC ₹20, CPL ₹200 aur CPA ₹2,000. Ab dikh jaata hai ki lead-to-sale rate 20% karne se CPA ₹1,000 ho jaata hai - jo CPC aadha karne se kaafi sasta hai.
when: Campaign profitable nahi hai aur dhoondhna hai kaunsa stage fail ho raha hai.
Launch se pehle CPC, CPL aur CPA ke targets set kar rahe ho.
Do channels compare kar rahe ho jo sirf ad spend par same lagte hain.
mistakes: CPC sudharna jab leak funnel mein neeche hai. Jo sasta click kabhi convert nahi hota, bekaar hai.
Channel ko last click par measure karna jab customer ne pehle teen touchpoints dekhe the.
CPA channels ke beech compare karna bina ye dekhe ki har channel ka customer kaisa hai.

gratuity.what: Gratuity wo lump sum hai jo employer tab deta hai jab aap paanch saal ya zyada ki continuous service ke baad job chhodte ho. Ye last drawn basic salary plus dearness allowance par banti hai, aapki poori monthly CTC par nahi - aur yahi ek baat log sabse zyada galat samajhte hain. Ye calculator Payment of Gratuity Act ke hisaab se statutory figure nikaalta hai, aapki salary aur completed years se, taki offer letter ya settlement se pehle number saamne ho.
gratuity.formula: Gratuity = last drawn basic + DA, guna 15, bhag 26, guna completed years. 15/26 statutory rate hai: har completed saal ke liye pandrah din ki salary, jahan mahina 26 working days ka maana jaata hai. To 50,000 basic plus DA aur 10 completed years par: 50,000 x 15 / 26 x 10 = 2,88,461. Act ke bahar wale employers bhi practically yahi 15/26 lagate hain, par salary base aur part-year ki rounding alag ho sakti hai.
when: Resign ya retire kar rahe ho aur HR ke settlement se pehle figure chahiye.
Do offers compare kar rahe ho aur dono ke end me gratuity kitni hogi, dekhna hai.
Final settlement letter ko statutory formula se check kar rahe ho.
mistakes: Poori CTC ko salary maan lena. Gratuity sirf basic plus DA par banti hai, isliye CTC-based estimate kaafi zyada aa jaata hai.
Part-years ko poore saal ginna. Sirf completed years ginte hain, jab tak paanchve saal me 240 din ya zyada service na ho.
Paanch saal se pehle gratuity ki ummeed rakhna. Paanch saal se kam continuous service par statutory haq banta hi nahi.

gross.what:
Gross Profit & Margin wo sawaal poochta hai jo trading mahina beech mein poochta hai, aakhir mein nahi: jo saaman asli mein dukaan se nikla, us par business ne paisa banaya ya sirf stock supplier se customer tak pahunchaya? rev period ka poora invoice hai, returns aur GST nikaal kar. cogs wahi saaman bechne layak banane ka kharcha hai — supplier ka bill, freight in, packing, marketplace ka commission, payment gateway ka cut aur wapas aane wale saaman ka provision. Tool Gross Profit rupees mein aur Gross Margin revenue ke percentage mein deta hai, aur ye jaan-boojh kar profit-and-loss ki pehli line hai — rent, salary, ads aur tax se pehle.

Rupees se dekho ki mahine mein kuch bana ya nahi, aur percentage se dekho ki business apne overheads utha sakta hai ya nahi: ₹2,70,000 gross profit strong lagta hai jab tak dikh na jaye ki wo ₹4,50,000 ki sales ka 60% hai, aur har salary aur ad usi 60% ke andar aani hai. Ek product ke level par rakho to ye pricing tool ban jaata hai; poore catalogue ka average banao to wo item chhup jaata hai jo till chalta rahe isliye chupchap loss par bik raha hai. Yahin markup aur margin bhi mix hote hain — ₹600 mein kharida, ₹1,000 mein becha price ka 40% margin hai par cost ka 67% markup, aur marketplace ko galat wala bata diya to price per unit sau rupaye hil jaata hai.
gross.formula: Gross Profit = rev − cogs. Gross Margin = (rev − cogs) ÷ rev × 100. Tool rev aur cogs leta hai aur Gross Profit rupees mein aur Gross Margin percentage mein deta hai. rev ₹4,50,000 aur cogs ₹1,80,000 par gross profit ₹2,70,000 aur margin 2,70,000 ÷ 4,50,000 = 60% hai. Ulti taraf chalao to target margin price tay karta hai: landed cost ko (1 − margin) se divide karo, to ₹600 par 40% margin ke liye 600 ÷ 0.6 = ₹1,000 chahiye. Us par 10% discount revenue ko ₹900 karta hai aur margin (900 − 600) ÷ 900 = 33% — price ka dasva hissa margin ka chauthai kha jaata hai, isliye discount ka faisla yahan lena chahiye, gut feel par nahi.
when: Naya product price kar rahe ho aur dekhna hai ki margin asli landed cost — freight, commission aur returns ke saath — par bachta hai ya nahi, supplier ke list price par nahi.
Mahina busy tha par bank balance hila nahi, aur jaanna hai leak maal mein hai ya profit-and-loss ke neeche.
Do suppliers ya do products saamne hain aur tay karna hai agli rupaye ki mehnat kaun deserve karta hai, sirf kaun per kilo sasta dikhta hai wo nahi.
mistakes: Gross profit ko profit samajhna. Rent, salary, ads, interest aur tax abhi isme se nahi gaye; gross margin wo pool hai jisme se sab peete hain, wo paisa nahi jo owner rakhta hai.

Sale ki apni direct cost cogs se bahar rakhna. Courier, packing, marketplace commission aur gateway fee sale na hone par nahi lagti, isliye wo cogs mein aati hain; bahar rakhne se margin kai point zyada dikhta hai.

Apne percentage ko doosre business se compare karna. Kirana ke liye 8-15% normal hai, apparel ke liye 40-55% aur software ke liye 70-90%; 60% ka koi matlab nahi jab tak apni industry ke saath na rakha jaye.
Poore catalogue ko ek figure mein average kar dena. Healthy company-level margin us best-seller ko chhupa sakta hai jo aise product ko subsidise kar raha hai jo har unit par paisa khota hai.

gst.what:
GST Calculator ek hi decision settle karta hai jo lagbhag har invoice par aata hai: saamne jo figure hai woh tax se pehle ka hai ya baad ka? Amount aur rate daaliye aur tool dono readings ek saath deta hai — tax-exclusive price par jodne wali GST, aur tax-inclusive price ke andar chhupi hui base — taaki aap andaza na lagayein ki supplier ne kis taraf quote kiya.

Jo reading logon ko phasati hai woh inclusive wali hai, kyunki GST ke saath batayi gayi price apne headline se chhoti base chhupati hai. ₹1,000 par 18% ka tax ₹180 hai aur bill ₹1,180; ulta karke wahi ₹1,180 bill ₹1,000 ki base rakhta hai, ₹1,000 minus 18% nahi. India mein rate aapke state ke andar bikri par CGST aur SGST ke roop mein lagta hai, ya state ke bahar ek IGST — par total tax dono tarah same rehta hai, sirf invoice par split badalta hai.
gst.formula: GST Amount = Base Price × GST Rate ÷ 100, aur final price Base Price + GST Amount hai. ₹1,000 base par 18% ka ₹180 tax aur ₹1,180 ka bill. Doosri taraf padhne ke liye ghatao mat, divide karo: 18% inclusive ₹1,180 ki base 1,180 ÷ 1.18 = ₹1,000 aur tax ₹180 hai. ₹1,180 se seedha 18% ghatao toh ₹967.60 aata hai, jo galat hai.
when: Supplier ne ek hi figure quote kiya ho aur samajh na aa raha ho ki GST usme shaamil hai ya nahi.
Invoice bana rahe ho aur tax line aur gross total alag-alag dikhane hain.
Do quotes compare kar rahe ho jisme ek tax-inclusive hai aur doosra nahi.
mistakes: Inclusive price se GST rate ghata dena, (1 + rate) se divide karne ki jagah. Subtraction base ko hamesha kam aur tax ko zyada dikhata hai.
Aisi price par GST jod dena jisme woh pehle se shaamil hai, jisse customer se tax do baar liya jaata hai.
Jo GST aap collect karte ho use apna paisa samajh lena. Woh sarkaar ke liye hota hai aur return mein dena padta hai.

homeemi.what:
Home Loan EMI Calculator us sabse badi udhaar ka number nikalta hai jo zyadatar parivaar zindagi me lete hain: flat ya ghar, bees se tees saal lamba, aur property par hi secured. Aap Loan Amount, Annual Interest Rate aur Loan Tenure saalo me daalte ho — saalo me, jaisa bank ke sanction letter me likha hota hai — aur tool fixed monthly EMI aur poore term ka Total Repayment deta hai. ₹30,00,000 par 8% aur 20 saal: EMI ₹25,093 aur total ₹60,22,368 — matlab borrowed amount ka lagbhag dugna wapas jaata hai, aur us dugne ka hissa monthly figure me dikhta hi nahi.

Yahan asli sawaal "₹25,093 de sakta hoon ya nahi" nahi hai, balki "kaun sa tenure, aur prepay kab karun" hai. Tenure EMI ko bahut kam hilata hai, byaaj ko bahut zyada: usi ₹30,00,000 par 8%, pandrah saal me ₹28,670 mahina aur kul ₹51,60,521, bees saal me ₹25,093 aur ₹60,22,368, tees saal me ₹22,013 aur ₹79,24,657 — lagbhag ₹3,000 mahine ki bachat ke liye ₹19 lakh zyada. Prepayment ka timing bhi utna hi matter karta hai, kyunki shuru ki EMI me zyada hissa byaaj hota hai: pehle mahine ₹25,093 me se ₹20,000 byaaj hai aur sirf ₹5,093 principal tak pahunchta hai.
homeemi.formula: Loan Tenure field saalo me hai, isliye tool pehle use instalment me badalta hai: n = Loan Tenure × 12, aur rate ko monthly: i = Annual Interest Rate ÷ 12 ÷ 100. Phir EMI = Loan Amount × i × (1+i)^n ÷ ((1+i)^n − 1), aur Total Repayment wahi EMI × n. Mahine-dar-mahine hisaab simple hai: interest = bachi hui balance × i, aur EMI ka jo bacha wo balance ghataata hai. ₹30,00,000 par 8% me i 0.006667 hai, isliye pehle mahine ₹20,000 byaaj aur ₹5,093 principal jaata hai; 137ve mahine me principal hissa byaaj se aage nikal jaata hai, uske baad har instalment bank ko kiraya dene se zyada apna ghar kharidti hai.
when: Aap ghar dhoond rahe ho aur offer dene se pehle dekhna hai ki EMI take-home pay ke lagbhag 40% me fit hoti hai ya nahi — sanction letter aane ke baad nahi.
Bank usi amount par 20 saal aur 30 saal ka option de raha hai, aur lamba tenure lene se pehle extra byaaj rupees me chahiye.
Ek lump-sum prepayment aur FD me paisa chhodne ke beech soch rahe ho, aur dekhna hai shuru ki EMI ka kitna hissa byaaj hai jo prepayment kaat degi.
mistakes: Tenure mahino me bhar dena. Field saalo me hai — 240 daalne par tool 240 saal ka loan price karta hai, jiski ₹30,00,000 par EMI ₹20,000 sirf byaaj cover karti hai aur principal kabhi nahi chukta.

Sirf EMI ka budget banana. Stamp duty aur registration property value ka 5-7%, processing fee, legal aur valuation charges, aur home insurance — sab pehle saal EMI ke bahar jaate hain, aur Total Repayment me kahin nahi dikhte.
EMI chhoti lagne se 30 saal ka tenure le lena. ₹30,00,000 par ye mahine ke lagbhag ₹3,000 bachata hai par ₹19,02,289 byaaj jodta hai — usi ghar ke liye lagbhag saat saal zyada ki instalments.
homeemi.hi_intro: ₹30,00,000 ka flat, 8% par bees saal — metro ke bahar pehle ghar ke liye aisa hi loan chahiye hota hai.
homeemi.hi_outro: Bees saal 8% par EMI ₹25,093 aur Total Repayment ₹60,22,368 deta hai, matlab borrowed amount ka lagbhag dugna. Pandrah saal kar do to EMI ₹28,670 ho jaati hai aur total ₹51,60,521 par aa jaata hai.

hra.what: HRA exemption calculator nikalta hai ki house rent allowance ka kitna hissa tax se bachta hai, aur zyadatar salaried log apne haq se kam claim karte hain. Exemption teen amounts mein sabse chhoti hoti hai: jo HRA actually milta hai, jo kiraya dete ho minus basic salary ka 10%, aur basic salary ka 50% agar metro mein rehte ho warna 40%. Kyunki sabse chhoti chunti hai, sabse kamzor kadi aapki exemption tay karti hai - isliye kiraya badhane se exemption sirf ek had tak badhti hai.
hra.formula: Exemption = inme sabse kam: (1) HRA received, (2) Rent paid − 10% of basic salary, (3) metro mein basic ka 50% ya warna 40%. Agar basic ₹6 lakh, HRA ₹3 lakh aur kiraya ₹2.4 lakh: option 2 ₹2.4 lakh − ₹60,000 = ₹1.8 lakh, option 3 metro mein ₹3 lakh, aur exemption sabse chhoti - ₹1.8 lakh. Dhyan rahe ye sirf old regime mein chalta hai.
when: Kiraya dete ho aur filing se pehle jaanna hai kitni exemption claim karni hai.
Old aur new tax regime mein se chun rahe ho aur comparison ke liye HRA figure chahiye.
Salary structure negotiate kar rahe ho aur HRA ki value dekhni hai.
mistakes: New regime mein HRA claim karna, jahan ye milta hi nahi.
Poora HRA exempt maan lena. Yeh teen amounts mein sabse chhoti hai, aur rent minus basic ka 10% aksar binding hota hai.
Ye bhool jaana ki family ko kiraya dena sirf tab allowed hai jab kiraya actually diya jaaye aur landlord income declare kare.

importduty.what: Import duty calculator nikalta hai ki customs se clear hone tak ek imported consignment ki asli cost kitni hoti hai - aur jawab hamesha invoice se zyada hota hai. Pehle customs duty lagti hai, phir IGST value plus duty par lagti hai, isliye dono jodne ke bajaye compound ho jaate hain. ₹1 lakh ka shipment, 20% duty aur 18% IGST: cost ₹1.38 lakh nahi, ₹1.42 lakh hoti hai, kyunki IGST ₹1 lakh par nahi, ₹1.2 lakh par lagti hai. Patle import margin par yahi gap decide karta hai ki product bikta hai ya nahi.
importduty.formula: Customs Duty = Product Value × Duty Rate. IGST = (Product Value + Customs Duty) × IGST Rate. Landed cost = Product Value + Customs Duty + IGST. ₹1,00,000 par 20% duty: duty ₹20,000, IGST ₹1,20,000 ka 18% = ₹21,600, landed cost ₹1,41,600. Duty rate product ke HSN code par depend karta hai, isliye price tay karne se pehle apne item ka exact rate confirm karo.
when: Import kar rahe ho aur selling price tay karne se pehle asli cost chahiye.
Imported product ko locally bane product se compare kar rahe ho.
Shipment aa gaya aur customs bill expectation se zyada hai - dekhna hai kyun.
mistakes: IGST sirf product value par lagana. Yeh value plus duty par lagti hai, isliye bill simple jod se hamesha bada aata hai.
Exact HSN code rate ke bajaye mota-moti duty rate use karna. Do codes ke beech 10 percentage point se zyada ka farq ho sakta hai.
Ye bhool jaana ki customs duty akela charge nahi hai - social welfare surcharge aur clearance charges bhi lagte hain.

impval.what:
Quote hamesha ek hisse me aata hai, poore price me nahi: koi angel kehta hai ₹10 lakh for 10%, accelerator kehta hai ₹40 lakh for 8%, aur ek forwarded message kehta hai company "5 crore par raise" kar rahi hai. Implied Valuation in sab hisson ko us ek number me badal deta hai jis par dono side baat kar sakti hain - poore company ka price - cheque ko us fraction se divide karke jo woh kharidta hai. ₹10 lakh for 10% matlab ₹1 crore ki company; ₹40 lakh for 8% matlab ₹5 crore ki company. Ye tool "main kitne ki hoon" se chhota par kaafi zyada kaam ka decision settle karta hai: yahi quote sasta hai, theek hai ya mehnga, sirf un do numbers se jo asli me bole gaye the.

Iska asli kaam cheque compare karne ki aadat todna hai. Bada cheque bade stake par chhota price bhi de sakta hai - ₹50 lakh for 25% company ko ₹2 crore par rakhta hai, jo ₹30 lakh for 10% ke ₹3 crore se kam hai - isliye offers price se rank hote hain, size se kabhi nahi. Answer ko aise padho jaise cheque aane ke baad company ki value, kyunki jo amount divide kiya woh total me pehle se hai; aur ise ek sentence ka hisaab samjho, valuation nahi: stake badlo, cheque do tranche me todo, ya usi round me ESOP pool nikaalo, aur wahi cheque alag price imply karne lagta hai.
impval.formula: Implied Valuation = amt ÷ (eq ÷ 100) - cheque ko stake se divide karo, stake fraction me. amt = ₹10,00,000 aur eq = 10 par divisor 0.10 hai, isliye 10,00,000 ÷ 0.10 = ₹1,00,00,000, yani ₹1 crore ki company. Kisi claim ko check karne ke liye ulta chalao: ek cheque jitna stake kharidta hai woh amt ÷ implied valuation × 100 hai, isliye ₹10 lakh ₹1 crore company me 10% hai, aur wahi ₹10 lakh ₹2 crore company me sirf 5%. amt wahi rakh kar eq double karo to implied price aadha ho jaata hai - isi wajah se do quotes ko compare karne se pehle dono ko is division se guzarna padta hai.
mistakes: Stake ko 10 likhna, us fraction ki jagah jo 10% darshata hai. Calculator eq ko pehle 100 se divide karta hai, isliye multiplier ki tarah type kiya gaya same quote sau guna chhota jawab deta hai.
Offers ko cheque ke size se rank karna. ₹50 lakh for 25% ₹2 crore imply karta hai aur ₹30 lakh for 10% ₹3 crore; bada cheque kharab price hai, aur ye sirf division se dikhta hai.

Answer ko paisa aane se pehle ka founder price samajhna. Cheque implied total ke andar hai, isliye ₹10 lakh for 10% se nikla ₹1 crore pre-money bata dena galat hai - round se theek pehle business usse kam ki thi.
when: Koi ek hi saans me cheque aur stake bolta hai aur aap us sentence ke andar chhupa poora company price jaanna chahte ho.
Do offers alag size aur alag stake ke saath aate hain aur aapko unhe cheque ki jagah price se rank karna hai.
Deck, pitch ya forwarded message ek hissa quote karta hai aur aap uska ganit parakhna chahte ho.
Team ko valuation dohraane se pehle aap us aakhri baar check karna chahte ho ki quote kahan se aaya tha.
impval.hi_intro: Ek investor ₹10 lakh de raha hai company ke 10% ke liye. Cheque aur stake ek hi price ke do roop hain; pehle ko doosre se divide karo aur sentence poore business ka ₹1 crore valuation ban jaata hai.
impval.hi_outro: ₹10 lakh for 10% company ko ₹1 crore par rakhta hai - upar wahi do field hain. Wahi ₹10 lakh 20% ke liye maango to implied price ₹50 lakh par aa jaata hai; koi bhi field badlo aur poore company ka number saath chalta hai.

incometax.what: Old vs new regime calculator batata hai ki is saal India ke do income tax systems mein se kaunsa aapse kam leta hai - aur jawab lagbhag har salary ke saath badalta hai. New regime slab rates kam deta hai par zyadatar deductions chheen leta hai. Old regime ke rates zyada hain par 80C, 80D, HRA aur home loan interest tax se pehle ghata sakte ho. Isliye comparison rates ka nahi hai - ye dekhna hai ki aapke deductions rate cut ko beat karte hain ya nahi. Jiske paas investments nahi, woh lagbhag hamesha new regime mein better hai; jiske paas bada home loan aur poora 80C hai, woh aksar old regime mein.
incometax.formula: Old regime: (Income − Deductions) par purane slabs se tax. New regime: Income par naye slabs se tax, lagbhag bina deductions. Jo tax kam, wahi jeeta. Saada ₹15 lakh salary, koi investment nahi: new regime aksar kam hota hai, kyunki ghata-ne ke liye zyada kuch hai hi nahi. ₹2 lakh home loan interest aur poora ₹1.5 lakh 80C jodo, toh old regime aage nikal sakta hai. Yahi crossover dhoondhna calculator ka kaam hai.
when: Employer saal ke shuru mein regime chunne bolta hai aur guess nahi karna.
Home loan liya ya 80C investments shuru kiye aur jawab badal gaya ho.
Do job offers compare kar rahe ho jinme salary structure alag hai.
mistakes: New regime ko hamesha better maan lena kyunki rates kam dikhte hain. Yeh sirf tab better hai jab deductions chhote hain.
Ye bhool jaana ki new regime mein standard deduction milta hai par 80C, 80D ya HRA nahi.
Pichhle saal ke numbers is saal ke slabs se compare karna. Dono regimes aur unke slabs pichhle kuch saalon mein ek se zyada baar badle hain.

landed.what: Landed cost matlab product ko apne warehouse tak laane ki asli kul cost, aur yeh lagbhag hamesha invoice se zyada hoti hai. Manufacturing pehli line hi hai - packaging, freight, insurance, customs clearance aur godown tak ki last-mile delivery sab usi unit par aate hain. Jo founder sirf manufacturing cost se price karta hai, usse mahino baad pata chalta hai ki woh loss par bech raha tha, kyunki jo number use kiya woh asli cost hi nahi thi.
landed.formula: Landed Cost per Unit = (Manufacturing + Packaging + Shipping + Other Costs) ÷ Units. 1,000 units ka batch, banane mein ₹4,00,000, pack karne mein ₹40,000, ship karne mein ₹60,000 aur baaki ₹30,000: (4,00,000 + 40,000 + 60,000 + 30,000) ÷ 1,000 = ₹530 per unit. Agar aap ₹500 par bech rahe the, toh har sale par ₹30 ka loss tha - aur yahi nikaalna is calculator ka poora point hai.
when: Selling price set kar rahe ho aur ek unit ki asli cost chahiye.
Domestic supplier ko imported supplier se compare kar rahe ho.
Check karna hai ki koi product line actually paisa bana rahi hai ya nahi.
mistakes: Manufacturing cost se price karna aur freight aur clearance chhod dena.
Tooling jaise one-off costs ko ek hi batch par baant dena, un volumes par nahi jinme woh kaam karenge.
Ye bhool jaana ki import par di gayi duties aur taxes baad mein credit ho sakti hain, isliye cash cost aur asli cost alag hote hain.

landunits.what: Land area unit converter square feet ko un units mein badalta hai jinme India mein zameen actually bikti hai - square yards, square metres, aur woh traditional units jo bahut states mein property deals par raaj karte hain: guntha, cent, bigha aur acre. Yeh maayne rakhta hai kyunki ek unit mein bataya plot aur doosre unit se compare karna barabar ka comparison nahi hai, aur traditional units state-dar-state badalte hain, toh ek state ka bigha doosre state ka bigha nahi hai.
landunits.formula: 1 square yard = 9 square feet. 1 square metre = 10.764 square feet. 1 acre = 43,560 square feet, matlab 4,840 square yards. 1 guntha = 1,089 square feet, toh 40 guntha ka ek acre. 1 cent = 435.6 square feet, toh 100 cent ka ek acre. 2,400 square feet ka plot 266.7 square yards ya takreeban 223 square metres hai - kaam ka jab buyer aur seller ek hi zameen ke liye alag units bol rahe hon.
when: Plot ek unit mein bataya hai aur doosre se compare karna hai.
Sale deed ya 7/12 extract padh rahe ho aur area apni samajh ke unit mein chahiye.
Listing ke liye traditional units aur square feet ke beech convert karna hai.
mistakes: Maanna ki bigha ya guntha poore India mein same hai. Ye units state aur kabhi district ke hisaab se badalte hain.
Square feet aur square yards mix kar dena, jinme nau guna ka farq hai.
Area convert karna par survey number aur boundaries deed se check na karna.

lovefun.what:
Love Calculator Your Name aur Their Name ko ek hi string mein jodta hai aur us string se ek percentage bana deta hai. Yeh ek name game hai jiska rule khula hua hai: sirf letters, ek fixed weighting, aur aakhir mein remainder. Kisi insaan ke baare mein kuch padha nahi jaata, aur kuch predict bhi nahi hota. Site ise entertainment likhti hai, aur yahi sahi description hai, baad mein chipkaya gaya disclaimer nahi.

Weighting hi samajhne wali cheez hai. Joined string mein pehla letter ek baar ginta hai, doosra do baar, teesra teen baar, aur aage bhi, isliye doosre naam ke aakhri letters answer ka bada hissa tay karte hain aur shuru ke letters mushkil se ginte hain. "Rahul" ke saath "Priya" 38% deta hai; order badal ke "Priya" ke saath "Rahul" karo toh wahi do log 94% padhte hain, kyunki har letter nayi position par chala gaya aur dobara weight ho gaya. Space, dot aur digit ginti se pehle hata diye jaate hain, isliye "Rahul K." bilkul "Rahul" jaisa score karta hai.
lovefun.formula: Tool name1 aur name2 ko type kiye gaye order mein jodta hai, lowercase karta hai, a se z ke bahar sab kuch hata deta hai, phir bachi hui string par index i ko 0 se shuru karke chalta hai. Har letter ke liye letterCode x (i + 1) running total mein judta hai aur total ko modulo 101 rakha jaata hai, jahan letterCode letter ka character code hai (a ke liye 97, b ke liye 98, aur aage bhi). Aakhri letter ke baad jo remainder bachta hai wahi percentage hai. "RahulPriya" is rule par 38 banta hai, isliye answer 38% aata hai. Wahi letters usi order mein hamesha wahi number dete hain, aur modulo 101 hi output ko 0 se 100 ke beech rakhta hai.
when: Group chat ke liye ek harmless number chahiye aur woh ek click mein chahiye.
Kisi ko dikhana hai ki sirf spelling hi score fix karti hai - ek letter badlo aur number hil jaata hai.
Ek aisa worked example dekhna hai jo prediction jaisa lagta hai par sirf letters par arithmetic hai.
mistakes: Percentage ko rishte ka faisla maan lena. Calculation ko log dikhte hi nahi, sirf unke type kiye letters dikhte hain.
Naam alag tarah se dobara type karke score upar karna. Sirf letters aur unka order ginte hain, isliye wahi jodi hamesha wahi number deti hai.
Ye sochna ki lamba naam zyada score karega. Total 101 se divide hone ke baad ka remainder hai, isliye lambi string chhote number par bhi pahunch sakti hai.

ltv.what:
Customer Lifetime Value batati hai ki ek customer poori rishtedaari me aapke liye kitne ka hai, sirf pehli sale ka nahi. Average order value, saal me kitni baar kharidta hai, kitne saal rukta hai, aur gross margin - inhe ek rupee figure me badal deti hai. Customer ₹1,000 ka saal me 4 baar, 3 saal, 50% margin pe - matlab ₹6,000 ka profit. LTV hi wo chhat hai jitna aap customer jeetne me kharch kar sakte ho; isse zyada diya toh har naya customer aapko garib karta hai.

Ye basket wala hisaab hai, repeat orders ke liye bana, contract ke liye nahi. Chaar field isko chalati hain: Average Order Value, Purchases per Year, Customer Lifespan aur Gross Margin. Basket chhota aur repeat rate zyada hone se ganit frequency pe turant hilta hai - saal me chaar order se paanch order karne par jawab chauthai badh jaata hai, jabki same order value wala one-off buyer sirf ek basket ka hai. Agar revenue monthly retainer me signed account se aata hai, toh account wala version use karo.
ltv.formula: LTV = Average Order Value × Saal me Purchases × Customer Lifespan (saal) × Gross Margin %. Margin maayne rakhta hai: ₹12,000 kharch karne wala customer 10% margin pe sirf ₹1,200 ka hai, ₹12,000 ka nahi. ₹1,000 × 4 × 3 × 50% = ₹6,000. Margin hi revenue ko us profit me badalta hai jo acquisition chukata hai.
when: Per buyer ad spend ka budget bana rahe ho aur uski hard limit chahiye.
Investor unit economics maangta hai aur LTV ko CAC ke saath dekhna hai.
High-margin niche aur high-volume business ke beech chunna hai.
mistakes: Revenue ko LTV maan lena - LTV gross margin pe banna chahiye, warna customer ki value zyada dikhti hai.
Ye maan lena ki customer saalon rukta hai kyunki kuch loyal hain; average lifespan aksar bahut kam hota hai.
Sirf pehli kharid ko lifetime value keh dena.

ltvcac.what: LTV:CAC ratio dono unit-economics numbers ko saath rakhta hai aur scaling ka ek hi asli sawaal ka jawab deta hai: customer jeetne ke har rupee pe kitne rupee profit wapas aate hain? Lifetime value ko acquisition cost se divide karo. 3:1 ya usse upar aam rule hai - 1:1 se neeche har customer pe nuksaan, aur 1 se 3 ke beech aap growth ke liye zyada kharch kar rahe ho. ₹4,50,000 ki LTV aur ₹1,80,000 ke CAC pe ratio 2.5:1 hai - theek, par abhi aaramdayak nahi.
ltvcac.formula: LTV : CAC = Customer Lifetime Value ÷ Customer Acquisition Cost. Dono taraf ek hi period aur ek hi basis pe hona chahiye - profit to profit. ₹4,50,000 LTV pe ₹1,80,000 CAC matlab 2.5 : 1. 1:1 se neeche business har sale pe paisa khota hai; 3:1 aur upar wo range hai jo investors dekhte hain.
when: Fundraise ki taiyari kar rahe ho aur unit-economics slide sahi chahiye.
Ad spend badhane wale ho aur jaanna hai ki ab bhi faayda hai.
Pehle margin theek karein ya acquisition cost, ye chunna hai.
mistakes: Revenue-based LTV ko fully-loaded CAC se compare karna - ratio theek dikhta hai jabki business paisa khota hai.
Blended CAC use karna jo wo channel chhupa deta hai jahan har customer pe nuksaan ho.
3:1 ko niyam maan lena; low-margin business ko zyada ratio chahiye, sticky business kam me chal jaata hai.

luckynumber.what:
Lucky Number Calculator sirf ek input leta hai, Date of Birth, aur 1 se 9 ke beech ek digit deta hai. Ye date ko aath digits (YYYYMMDD) me likhta hai, sabko jodta hai, aur us total ke digits tab tak jodta rehta hai jab tak ek digit na bache. 15 June 1995 se 1+9+9+5+0+6+1+5 = 36, phir 3+6 = 9.

Is page ki asli baat ye hai ki digits jodne se kisi number ka nau se bhaag dene par bacha remainder kabhi nahi badalta. Isliye jawab seedha date mod 9 hota hai, aur remainder 0 ho to 9 dikhaya jaata hai. Har raasta wahi digit deta hai: din, mahina aur saal alag-alag reduce karke jodo ya aathon digits ek saath. Isi wajah se number nau saal ke cycle me dohrata hai, to 15 June 1995, 15 June 2004 aur 15 June 2013 teeno 9 hain.
luckynumber.formula: Date of Birth se hyphen hata kar YYYYMMDD ke aath digits jodo. Jab tak total nau se zyada ho, use uske apne digits ke sum se badal do. 1995-06-15 se 1+9+9+5+0+6+1+5 = 36, phir 3+6 = 9. Loop sirf ek digit par rukta hai, isliye 11 ya 22 yahan master number ke roop me nahi rehte. Digit sum nau se bhaag dene par remainder nahi badalta, to jawab YYYYMMDD mod 9 ke barabar hota hai, aur remainder 0 par 9. Asli date ka total kabhi zero nahi hota, isliye answer hamesha 1-9.
when: Koi profile ya numerology reading date of birth ka birth number maangti hai aur aapko bina haath se reduce kiye digit chahiye.
Koi number batata hai aur aap dekhna chahte ho ki kaunsi dates usse bana sakti hain - nau din ya nau saal ke farak wali dates ek hi digit deti hain.
Aap do logon ki dates compare kar rahe ho aur dekhna chahte ho ki wo ek hi digit par aati hain ya nahi.
mistakes: Do digit ke total par ruk jaana. 36 answer nahi hai; tool use phir 9 tak reduce karta hai, aur 11, 22 ya 33 ko master number nahi maanta.
Ye maanna ki order matter karta hai. Din, mahina aur saal alag-alag reduce karke jodne par bhi wahi digit aata hai, kyunki digit sum modulo 9 par same rehta hai.
Digit ko roz ka forecast samajhna. Ye birth date se fix hota hai aur ek din se doosre din nahi badalta.
luckynumber.hi_intro: Sirf date of birth daalni hai, to jawab type karte hi fix ho jaata hai: 15 June 1995 pehle 36 banti hai aur phir 9.
luckynumber.hi_outro: Nau saal baad bhi wahi din 9 hi deta hai - 2004-06-15 aur 2013-06-15 dono 9 par aate hain, kyunki nau saal ka step digit total ko nau ke multiple se badalta hai. Date of Birth badlo aur digit bhi badal jaata hai.

marketplace.what: Marketplace Fee Calculator dikhata hai ki Amazon, Flipkart ya Meesho par order ke baad platform apna hissa kaatne ke baad aapke account me asli kitna aata hai. Commission headline charge hai, par aksar wo akela nahi hota: shipping, closing fee, payment-gateway charge aur koi fixed other fees bhi usi order se nikalte hain. Tool in sab ko selling price se ghata kar wo amount dikhata hai jo aapko milta hai. Yahi number tay karta hai ki product ko us price par list karna theek hai ya nahi.
marketplace.formula: Total fees = selling price x commission rate / 100 + shipping fee + other fees. You receive = selling price minus total fees. Commission selling price par lagta hai, aapki cost par nahi, isliye 1,000 rupaye ke item par 15% commission 150 rupaye hai — chahe aapne use 300 me banaya ho ya 800 me. Apni asli shipping aur other fees daalo, andaaza nahi.
when: Jab aap marketplace ke liye product price kar rahe ho aur gross price nahi, net payout chahiye.
Jab aap ek hi product do marketplaces ke alag fee table par compare kar rahe ho.
Jab commission slab badla ho aur aap dekhna chahte ho ki price ka kitna hissa chala gaya.
mistakes: Sirf commission rate dekhna aur shipping aur closing fee bhool jaana, jo cut ko dugna kar sakte hain.
Ye maan lena ki fee aapki cost par lagti hai. Ye selling price par lagti hai, isliye patla-margin item loss me ja sakta hai.
Commission par GST bhool jaana, jo platform apni fee par leta hai.

marketshare.what: Market share calculator ek saada sawaal ka jawab deta hai: aapke market mein jo kuch bika, usme se kitna aapka hai? Market mein bike total units aur aapke bike units daalo, bas. Market share maayne rakhta hai kyunki yeh aapki growth ko market ki growth ke saath tolta hai - agar aap 20% badhe par market 40% badha, toh aapka share gir gaya, chahe revenue badhi ho. Investors ise dekhkar batate hain ki aap jeet rahe ho ya sirf tez bah rahe ho.
marketshare.formula: Market Share % = (Your Units Sold ÷ Total Market Units) × 100. Aapne 12,000 units beche aur market mein 1,00,000 bike, toh share 12% hai. Value share ke liye wahi formula revenue par lagao. 12% se 15% jaana 3 percentage point ka gain hai par 25% ka rise - aur yeh farq batana zaroori hai kyunki dono sahi lagte hain.
when: Investor ko batana hai ki aap market mein kahaan khade ho.
Apni growth ko market ki growth se compare karna hai.
Kisi naye segment mein enter karne se pehle size dekhni hai.
mistakes: Apna share apne pichhle saal se compare karna aur market ki growth bhool jaana.
Market ko bahut chhota ya bahut bada define karna, jisse share bekaar ho jaata hai.
Volume share aur value share mix kar dena - premium brand ka value share zyada hota hai.

markup.what: Markup aur margin ek hi profit ko batane ke do tareeke hain, aur inhe mix kar dena business ki sabse mehngi chhoti galtiyon mein se ek hai. Markup profit hai aapki cost ka percentage. Margin profit hai aapke selling price ka percentage. Isliye ek hi sale par markup hamesha bada number hota hai. Jo trader markup mein sochta hai par distributor ko margin bata deta hai, woh khud ko 20% kam price par pa sakta hai.
markup.formula: Markup % = (Selling Price − Cost Price) ÷ Cost Price × 100. Margin % = (Selling Price − Cost Price) ÷ Selling Price × 100. ₹600 mein kharido, ₹1,000 mein becho: profit ₹400, jo 66.7% markup hai par sirf 40% margin. Yahi gap hai isliye '40% margin' wala product '40% markup' wala nahi hota, aur dono confuse karne se bade order par asli paisa jaata hai.
when: Product ki pricing kar rahe ho aur profit dono tarah se sahi batana hai.
Buyer margin maang raha hai aur usse woh price nikaalni hai jo charge karni padegi.
Competitor ki pricing se compare kar rahe ho aur barabar ka number chahiye.
mistakes: Buyer ko margin ki jagah markup bata dena, jisse aapki price zyada lagti hai.
Cost par margin jodkar selling price nikaalna, jabki margin selling price ka hissa hota hai.
Ye bhool jaana ki discount dene par dono numbers girti hain, kyunki selling price badal gaya.

moicirr.what: MOIC aur IRR wahi do numbers hain jin par venture investor actually deal judge karta hai. MOIC saada hai: paisa kitne guna wapas aaya. ₹1 daala aur ₹3 mile, matlab 3x. IRR wahi natija saalana rate mein batata hai, aur yahi number do deals ko comparable banata hai. Teen saal mein 3x aur das saal mein 3x bilkul ek achievement nahi hai - pehla takreeban 44% saalana hai, doosra takreeban 12%. Jo founder ye do numbers bolna seekh jaata hai, usse cheque likhne wale galat nahi samajhte.
moicirr.formula: MOIC = Exit Amount ÷ Investment Amount. IRR woh saalana rate hai jisse investment exit value tak pahunchta hai: IRR = (Exit ÷ Investment)^(1 ÷ Years) − 1. ₹1 crore 5 saal mein ₹3 crore: 3x MOIC aur takreeban 24.6% IRR. Wahi ₹3 crore 10 saal mein: 3x MOIC par IRR sirf takreeban 11.6%. Investors aksar 3x ya zyada aur 25% ya behtar chahte hain.
when: Pitch kar rahe ho aur valuation ke saath-saath round ka return dikhana hai.
Do offers compare kar rahe ho jinke amount aur period alag hain.
Apne investors ko report de rahe ho aur MOIC aur IRR sahi likhna hai.
mistakes: Multiple batana par saal nahi. 3x ka koi matlab nahi jab tak period na bolo.
IRR compare karna bina ye note kiye ki IRR maanta hai paisa usi rate par reinvest hota hai, jo aksar nahi hota.
Partial exit par MOIC ko poora picture maan lena - aadha hissa becha toh multiple bhi aadha hi realised hai.

momyoy.what: Month-on-month is mahine ko pichhle mahine se compare karta hai. Year-on-year is mahine ko pichhle saal ke usi mahine se. Lagbhag har Indian business ke liye YoY imaandaar number hai, kyunki Diwali, monsoon aur school calendar demand ko itna hilate hain ki MoM zyada tar festival naapta hai, business nahi. Calculator dono deta hai, aur dono ka gap hi seasonality hai.
momyoy.formula: MoM % = (This Month - Last Month) / Last Month x 100. YoY % = (This Month - Same Month Last Year) / Same Month Last Year x 100.
when: Ek mahina kharab lagta hai aur jaanna hai ki seasonality hai ya asli decline.
Investor ko present karna hai aur festive distortion ke bina growth dikhani hai.
Agle quarter ka target set kar rahe ho aur seasonal baseline chahiye.
mistakes: Festive mahine ki MoM growth ko trend bata dena. October hamesha September se upar hota hai.
31 din ke mahine ko 28 din wale se bina days normalise kiye compare karna.
Ek saal se chhote business par YoY lagana - compare karne ke liye kuch hai hi nahi.

mrpreverse.what: MRP reverse calculator pack par chhapi price se shuru karke ulta nikalta hai ki manufacturer ke roop mein aapko actually kitna milta hai. Yeh direction Indian founders ko sabse zyada chahiye, kyunki market MRP aapse bahut pehle tay kar deta hai - competitor ki ₹499 ki bottle wahi price hai jiske saath aapka product baithna hai. Usse retailer ka cut aur distributor ka cut ghatao, jo bachta hai woh aapka landing price hai. Agar woh number aapki cost se neeche hai, toh kitni bhi volume isse theek nahi karegi.
mrpreverse.formula: Landing Price = MRP × (1 − Retailer Margin %) × (1 − Distributor Margin %). ₹500 MRP, 20% retailer aur 10% distributor margin: ₹500 × 0.80 × 0.90 = ₹360 aapka landing price. Agar cost of goods ₹300 hai, gross margin ₹60 ya 16.7%. Agar cost ₹380 hai, toh har unit par ₹20 ka loss - aur MRP wahi cheez hai jo badalni padegi.
when: Product kis price par bikna chahiye ye pata hai aur usme aapka margin kya bachta hai dekhna hai.
Retailer zyada discount maang raha hai aur dekhna hai factory gate par kitna padta hai.
Ek hi product ke do MRP points compare kar rahe ho.
mistakes: Dono margins MRP se ek saath ghata dena, ek ke baad ek nahi - doosra margin chhote number par lagta hai.
GST bhool jaana, jo zyadatar cases mein MRP ke bahar hota hai aur aap actually kitna collect karte ho woh badalta hai.
Margins fix maan lena. Alag formats ke retailers ek hi product par bilkul alag cut lete hain.

netmargin.what: Net Profit Margin Calculator do figure — revenue aur net profit — ko us ek percentage me badal deta hai jo batata hai ki sales ke har rupaye me se business asli me kitna rakhta hai. Net profit last line hai: cost of goods ke baad, salary aur rent ke baad, loan ke interest ke baad, aur tax ke baad. Isliye ye teen margin numbers me sabse chhota aur sabse sachcha hai.
netmargin.formula: Net margin = net profit ÷ revenue × 100 (`np` ÷ `rev` × 100). Agar business ₹4,50,000 revenue kamaye aur har cost aur tax ke baad ₹1,80,000 bachaye, to net margin 1,80,000 ÷ 4,50,000 = 40% hai. Net profit wo bachta hai jo cost of goods, operating expenses, interest aur tax ke baad rehta hai; inme se koi bhi kam ho to percentage badh jaata hai.
when: Aap jaanna chahein ki sales ke har rupaye me se sab kuch dene ke baad business kitna rakhta hai.
Apne margin ko usi tarah ka product ya service bechne walon se compare kar rahe ho.
Accounts ya pitch taiyaar kar rahe ho aur bottom-line percentage chahiye jo investor poochta hai.
mistakes: Margin ko doosri industry ke business se compare karna. Grocery chain ka 3% theek ho sakta hai jabki software company ka 3% mushkil me hai; sahi comparison apne hi trade me hai.
Profit before tax ko net keh dena. Net matlab tax aur interest ke baad, isliye wahi revenue par operating margin se kam hota hai.
Chhoti revenue par bada percentage dekh kar business ko strong maan lena. ₹4,50,000 ka 40% matlab ₹1,80,000 — chhoti turnover par bada margin bhi chhota profit hi hai.

nps.what: NPS yaani National Pension Scheme, sarkar ka PFRDA ke through chalaya gaya retirement account hai. Aap har saal paisa daalte ho, wo aapke chune equity aur debt funds me invest hota hai, aur 60 saal se pehle nikal nahi sakte. Return fixed nahi hai - funds par depend karta hai. Calculator aapki monthly contribution, umar aur maan liye gaye return se 60 par corpus project karta hai, taaki pata chale ki aaj ki saving se wahi retirement milega ya nahi.
nps.formula: Corpus = Monthly Contribution x [((1 + r)^n - 1) / r] x (1 + r), jahan r monthly rate (annual / 12) aur n 60 tak ke mahine. Iske upar employer ka basic ka 14% (Section 80CCD(2)) aur 80CCD(1B) ke tahat extra 50,000 rupaye ki deduction judti hai.
when: Aap salaried ho aur jaanna chahte ho ki 80CCD(1B) ki extra 50,000 rupaye deduction ki asli value kitni hai.
NPS aur PPF me choose kar rahe ho aur dono ka corpus saath dekhna chahte ho.
Aap dekhna chahte ho ki 10 saal late start karne par kya hota hai - jawab usually brutal hota hai.
mistakes: Calculator ka return guaranteed maan lena. NPS equity funds upar-neeche hote hain; 10% planning number hai, promise nahi.
Ye bhoolna ki 60 par corpus ka 40% annuity kharidna padta hai. Withdraw karne wala lump sum dikhaye corpus se kam hai.
NPS ko sirf tax par ELSS se compare karna. NPS paisa 60 tak lock karta hai; ELSS 3 saal me khulta hai.

numerology.what:
Numerology Calculator do fields, Name aur Date of Birth, ko milakar 1 se 9 ke beech ek digit banata hai. Ye wo alphabet-position wala sum nahi hai jo zyadatar numerology sites use karti hain: ye tool naam ke har letter ka character code jodta hai, to A ka 65 aur a ka 97 ginta hai, phir date of birth ka digit total jodta hai aur sab kuch ek digit tak reduce karta hai. Sirf "Aarav" ka sum 491 banta hai aur 5 rehta hai; 14 August 2019 milao to total 516 hota hai aur 3 aata hai.

Kyunki letter ka case badalne par uske code me 32 ka farak aata hai, ek hi naam teen alag jawab de sakta hai: "Aarav" 5 hai, "ARAAV" 3 hai aur "aarav" 1 hai. Space, hyphen aur baaki punctuation ginti se pehle hata diye jaate hain, isliye "Aarav " aur "Aarav" bilkul same hain. Number sirf letters, unke case aur field me maujood digits par depend karta hai, aur kisi aur cheez par nahi.
numerology.formula: Name me se letters aur digits ke alawa sab hata do, phir bache har character ka character code jodo (A = 65, a = 97, digit 2 = 50). Date of Birth ke aath digits ka digit sum jodo, phir running total ko uske apne digits ke sum se tab tak badal do jab tak 1 se 9 ka ek digit na bache. "Aarav" ka 65+97+114+97+118 = 491, phir 4+9+1 = 14, phir 1+4 = 5. 2019-08-14 (2+0+1+9+0+8+1+4 = 25) jodo to total 516 banta hai, jo 12 aur phir 3 hota hai.
when: Aapke paas naam aur date of birth dono hain aur aapko do alag readings ke bajaye ek combined digit chahiye.
Aap ek hi naam ki spellings ya capitalisation compare kar rahe ho aur dekhna chahte ho ki wo kitna alag aate hain.
Koi numerology number batata hai aur aap check karna chahte ho ki wo is character-code method se aaya hai ya alphabet-position method se - dono kabhi match nahi karte.
mistakes: Ye maanna ki ye classical reading se match karta hai. Alphabet-position numerology "Aarav" ko alag number deti hai, kyunki ye tool position ke bajaye character code jodta hai, to dono methods kabhi match nahi karte.
Ye umeed karna ki aage ka space ya hyphen farak layega. Wo ginti se pehle hat jaate hain, isliye "Aarav ", "Aar-av" aur "Aarav" teeno 5 hain.
Naam me case mila dena. Surname capital me aur pehla naam small me likhne par har letter ka total 32 badal jaata hai, isliye "Aarav" (5) aur "ARAAV" (3) alag ho jaate hain.
numerology.hi_intro: Sirf naam hi kaafi hai: "Aarav" ka sum 491 banta hai aur 5 rehta hai. Date of birth milao to wahi field doosre digit par chala jaata hai.
numerology.hi_outro: 14 August 2019 jodne par total 516 hota hai aur jawab 3 aata hai. Naam small letters me likho to ye 1 par gir jaata hai - har letter par 32 ka farak, isliye naam ka case bhi jawab ka hissa hai.

numwords.what: Number to words number ko Indian tareeke se shabdon mein likhta hai - lakh aur crore, million aur billion nahi. Yeh cheque, invoice, legal document, rent agreement aur har aise form ke liye bana hai jisme amount shabdon mein maangta hai. Cheque par amount shabdon mein likhna isliye zaroori hai ki agar figure mein koi badlav ho toh shabd wala version maanya hota hai, aur banks isi ko dekhte hain. Indian numbering system har teen digit par comma lagata hai, isliye yahan million-billion wala conversion seedha kaam nahi karta.
numwords.formula: Indian grouping right se teen digit ke blocks mein hoti hai - pehle hazaar, phir lakh, phir crore. 12,34,567 padha jaata hai 'twelve lakh thirty four thousand five hundred sixty seven'. ₹10,00,000 'ten lakh' hai aur ₹1,00,00,000 'one crore'. Ulta conversion - crore ko million mein badalna - ke liye 1 crore = 10 million aur 1 lakh = 100,000 yaad rakho.
when: Cheque ya demand draft par amount shabdon mein likhni hai.
Legal document ya rent agreement mein figure shabdon mein chahiye.
Kisi foreign document ke liye crore aur lakh ko million mein badalna hai.
mistakes: Million aur billion wala conversion Indian form par lagana, jahan lakh aur crore chahiye.
Comma galat jagah lagana. Indian system 12,34,567 likhta hai, 1,234,567 nahi.
Cheque par figure aur shabd match na hona - aisi cheque bank reject kar sakta hai.

opmargin.what:
Operating Margin batata hai ki business apne trading se paisa bana raha hai ya nahi — us paise ki lagat aur tax se pehle jo usne udhaar liya. Revenue aur operating profit daalo, aur tool dikhata hai ki sales ke har rupee ka kitna hissa bacha. Core operation chalta hai ya nahi, iska ye sabse saaf single reading hai, kyunki financing aur one-off items isse bahar rehte hain.

Farq ye hai ki “operating profit” kya chhodta hai. Loan ka interest is baat ki lagat hai ki business funded kaise hua, na ki wo kya bechta hai; tax company ki poori position par depend karta hai; ek baar wali asset sale trading nahi hai. Ye sab hata do to margin akela engine dikhata hai. Isliye ye EBITDA ke saath rehta hai, uski jagah nahi: EBITDA me depreciation aur amortisation wapas jod diye jaate hain, isliye asset-light business me dono saath chalte hain aur factory wale business me alag ho jaate hain.
opmargin.formula: Operating Margin = Operating Profit ÷ Revenue × 100. Revenue (rev) top line hai; Operating Profit (ebit) wo hai jo cost of goods sold aur operating expenses ke baad bachta hai, lekin interest aur tax se pehle. ₹45,000 revenue par ₹18,000 operating profit matlab 40% margin. 10% se upar aam taur par healthy core maana jaata hai; negative margin matlab operation khud paisa gawa raha hai aur koi financing isko theek nahi kar sakti.
when: Jab mahina busy tha par bank me kuch nahi bacha, aur aap jaanna chahte ho problem operation me hai ya financing me.
Jab aap apne business ko competitor se compare kar rahe ho aur wo ek number chahiye jo funding ko ignore kare.
Jab aap buyer ya lender ke liye tayyaar ho rahe ho aur core business ko alag dikhana chahte ho.
mistakes: Operating profit ki jagah net profit daal dena. Interest aur tax operating cost nahi hain, isliye margin kam dikhta hai.
Do company ka margin bina ye dekhe compare karna ki unme operating kya ginta hai. Ek marketing ko operating me rakhti hai, doosri one-off maanti hai.
Ek quarter ko trend maan lena. One-off cost aur seasonality se margin hilta rehta hai; direction par bharosa karo.

payback.what: CAC payback period batata hai ki customer ko jeetne me jo kharch hua, wo us customer ke profit ke kitne mahine me wapas aata hai. Ye LTV:CAC ratio ka cash-flow version hai: accha ratio bhi itna lamba payback chhupa sakta hai ki paisa profit se pehle khatam ho jaaye. Acquisition cost, per customer monthly revenue aur gross margin daaliye - kitne mahine, ye mil jaata hai. Barah mahine se kam payback se aap jaldi dobara invest kar sakte ho; teen saal matlab har naya customer us paise pe daanv hai jo der se aayega.
payback.formula: Payback Period (months) = CAC ÷ (Monthly Revenue per Customer × Gross Margin %). Customer jeetne me ₹5,000 lage, wo ₹1,000 mahina deta hai aur 40% margin rakhte ho toh payback ₹5,000 ÷ ₹400 = 12.5 mahine. Margin hi payback ko asli banata hai; sirf revenue pe wahi customer paanch mahine ka payback dikhata hai jo kabhi aata hi nahi.
when: Tay kar rahe ho ki acquisition pe kitna aggressive kharch karna hai.
Paisa raise kiya hai aur jaanna hai ki kitni jaldi naye customers me badlega.
Do segments compare kar rahe ho jinki payback speed alag hai.
mistakes: Denominator me revenue use karna gross-margin profit ke bajaye, jisse payback aadha dikhta hai.
Ye bhoolna ki lamba payback tabhi chalega jab funding ka paisa bank me pehle se ho.
Churn ignore karna - jo customer payback ke mahine se pehle chala gaya, wo cost kabhi wapas nahi karta.

percent.what: Percentage calculator us sabse aam money sawaal ka jawab deta hai: is number ka X% kitna hai, aur agar result itna hai toh woh kitne percent hai? Har discount, har tax rate, har growth figure aur har margin andar se percentage hi hai, isliye poori site isi tool par khadi hai. Jaal ye hai ki percentages jodte nahi jaise log sochte hain - 20% badhne ke baad 20% gire toh aap wahi nahi rehte, 4% neeche rehte ho.
percent.formula: Number ka percentage = Number × Percentage ÷ 100. ₹2,400 par 15% discount ₹360 hai, toh aap ₹2,040 dete ho. Ulta: agar 15% off ke baad ₹2,040 diye, toh original 2,040 ÷ 0.85 = ₹2,400 hai. Aur do numbers ke beech badlav = (New − Old) ÷ Old × 100, isse pata chalta hai ki woh 'bada' rise actually bada hai ya nahi.
when: Bill par discount ya tax check kar rahe ho.
Jaanna hai koi number kitne percent badha ya ghata.
Margin ya kisi total ka hissa nikaal rahe ho.
mistakes: Percentages ko simple numbers ki tarah jodna-ghatana. Ye compound hote hain, aur order maayne rakhta hai.
Naye number se rise nikaalna purane se nahi. Base badalne se jawab badal jaata hai.
Percentage points aur per cent ko same samajh lena. 4% se 6% jaana 2 percentage point ka rise hai par 50% ka increase.

pitchscore.what: Shark Tank pitch check aapke numbers ko un sawaalon par chalata hai jo sharks actually poochte hain, aur batata hai kaunse sawaalon par aapko grilling milegi. Shark Tank India par jaanch-paraakh kaafi consistent hai: aapki valuation kya hai aur kyun, revenue aur margins kya hain, customer paane mein kitna lagta hai, aur kitne mahine ka cash bacha hai? Jis pitch ke paas in chaaron ke saaf jawab hain, woh room mein tik jaati hai.
pitchscore.formula: Koi ek formula nahi hai - check ratios dekhta hai. Valuation vs revenue batata hai ask kitna mehnga hai. LTV vs CAC batata hai growth profitable hai ya nahi; 3:1 se neeche sharks push back karte hain. Runway mahino mein batata hai business ke paas kitna waqt hai. Gross margin batata hai ki product apni growth fund kar sakta hai ya nahi. ₹1 crore revenue par ₹10 crore valuation 10x multiple hai, aur pitch ko woh justify karna padta hai.
when: Pitch taiyaar kar rahe ho aur pehle apne kamzor numbers jaanna chahte ho.
Investor ne metrics maange hain aur unhe sanity-check karna hai.
Raise karne se pehle kya theek karna hai ye decide kar rahe ho.
mistakes: Valuation lekar aana jise support karne ke liye revenue nahi hai. Multiple sabse pehle poochha jaata hai.
CAC aur LTV pata na hona jab poocha jaaye, jisse lagta hai apna business nahi jaante.
Aisa burn rate batana jisse runway chhota nikle aur uske liye plan na ho.

ppf.what:
PPF Calculator ek hi 15-saal ka sawaal hal karta hai: agar main har saal Public Provident Fund mein same amount daalta rahoon, to lock-in khatam hone par account mein kitna hota hai? PPF India ke un gine-chune instruments mein se ek hai jo teenon stages par exempt hai - contribution (Section 80C ke tehat), saalana interest, aur maturity amount - isliye ye maturity figure wahi paisa hai jo aap actually rakhte ho, baad mein tax ka koi kata nahi. Aap Yearly Contribution, Annual Interest Rate aur Tenure daalte ho; ye Total Contribution aur Estimated Maturity deta hai.

PPF ko same rate ke FD se alag rate nahi, tax aur discipline banata hai. 7.1% ka FD har saal apne interest par aapke slab ke hisaab se tax deta hai, isliye 30% taxpayer ke paas 5% ke aas-paas bachta hai; PPF ke 7.1% ko koi nahi chhoota. Calculator ye gap seedha dikhata hai: same Yearly Contribution aur same rate par chalao aur maturity ko ek taxed deposit ki post-tax value se compare karo. Account par ₹1.5 lakh saalana ceiling hai aur 15-saal ka term jo paanch saal ke blocks mein badhaya ja sakta hai, isliye Tenure ek input hai, fixed 15 nahi.
ppf.formula: Har saal ki contribution PPF rate par utne saal compound hoti hai jitne wo account mein rehti hai, isliye maturity ek ordinary annuity ka future value hai, seedha multiplication nahi. Tool a = rate / 100 aur n = years set karta hai, phir Estimated Maturity = Yearly Contribution x ((1 + a)^n - 1) / a, aur Total Contribution = Yearly Contribution x n. ₹1,00,000 saalana, 7% aur 15 saal par a = 0.07 aur n = 15, to (1.07^15 - 1) / 0.07 = 25.129; maturity = ₹25,12,900 aur Total Contribution = ₹15,00,000. Calculator har saal ki deposit saal ke ant mein credit karta hai; asli account mein April ki contribution poore saal ka interest kamaati hai, jo tool model nahi karta, isliye figure ko conservative maano.
when: Section 80C ke ₹1.5 lakh kahan lagayein ye decide kar rahe ho, aur PPF ki tax-free maturity ko same rate ke FD ya debt fund ki taxed maturity ke saath dekhna chahte ho.
Kuch saal se PPF mein daal rahe ho aur jaanna chahte ho ki current Yearly Contribution 15-saal ki maturity tak kya banta hai, extend karne se pehle.
15 saal door ke goal ke liye PPF ko equity SIP se compare kar rahe ho, aur PPF taraf ka guaranteed, tax-free floor jaanna chahte ho.
mistakes: Jo interest expect kar rahe ho wo daalna, current PPF rate nahi. Rate har quarter government reset karti hai, isliye maturity bhi badalti hai - calculator utna hi sahi hai jitna Annual Interest Rate mein type kiya.

Estimated Maturity ko interest earned samajhna. Us figure mein aapki khud ki Total Contribution bhi hai; gain = Estimated Maturity minus Total Contribution, aur yahi FD ke post-tax interest se compare karne wala number hai.

15 saal ka figure year 15 par kharch karne layak maan lena bina extension plan kiye. PPF 15 saal par mature hota hai par paanch saal ke blocks mein extend ho sakta hai, aur Tenure input se wahi lamba run test hota hai.

prepost.what:
Ek funding round me ek hi company ke do price hote hain, aur dono ke beech ka gap bilkul cheque hai. Pre-money woh value hai jis par dono side maante hain ki naya paisa aane se pehle business ki thi; post-money woh value plus cheque hai, aur round ka har percentage post-money par naapa jaata hai, pre-money par nahi. ₹90,00,000 pre-money aur ₹10,00,000 cheque daalo to company ₹1,00,00,000 par close hoti hai aur investor ko 10% milta hai. Ye tool ye settle karta hai ki signature ki asli keemat kya hai: pre-money woh number hai jis par aap negotiate karte ho, post-money woh number hai jise aapka cap table maanta hai, aur in dono ko mila dena hi woh galti hai jisme founder apne irade se zyada stake de deta hai.

Ye offer ka jawab dene se pehle use ulta padhne ka tareeka bhi hai. Jab investor kehta hai ₹10 lakh se 10% milna chahiye, to maanga ja raha pre-money ₹90,00,000 hai, aur bahas usi figure par honi chahiye; agar wahi cheque 20% kharidta bataya jaaye to implied pre-money ₹40,00,000 par gir jaata hai aur baat bilkul doosri ho jaati hai. Kyunki stake hamesha us total se divide hota hai jisme cheque shamil hai, round pre-money par tay hota hai aur post-money par check hota hai - aur pre-money me se nikaala gaya ESOP pool trust ko asli shares deta hai, jisse founder ki holding us simple split se kam ho jaati hai jo post-money dikhata hai.
prepost.formula: Post-money Valuation = pre + amt, aur Equity Given = amt ÷ post-money × 100. pre = ₹90,00,000 aur amt = ₹10,00,000 par post-money ₹1,00,00,000 hai aur cheque 10,00,000 ÷ 1,00,00,000 = 10.0% kharidta hai. Term sheet parakhne ke liye wahi jodi ulti chalao: ₹10 lakh se 10% matlab ₹90,00,000 pre-money, jabki ₹10 lakh se 20% matlab ₹50,00,000 post-money aur isliye sirf ₹40,00,000 pre-money. Dono price ke beech ki doori har case me cheque hi hoti hai, use koi aur cheez nahi hilati.
mistakes: Cheque ko pre-money se divide karna. ₹90,00,000 pre-money ke saamne ₹10 lakh ₹1,00,00,000 company ka 10% hai, woh 11.1% nahi jo 10 ÷ 90 deta hai.

Post-money ko negotiated price samajhna. Ye derived hai - pre-money plus cheque - isliye usi par anchor karna investor ka stake aur aapka dilution dono adhoora chhod deta hai jab tak pre-money tay nahi hota.

ESOP pool split ke baad nikaalna. Pre-money me se banaya gaya 10% pool founders ko do baar dilute karta hai: investor phir bhi post-money ka 10% leta hai aur pool bache hisse ka ek aur tukda le leta hai.
when: Term sheet me pre-money aur cheque aata hai aur aapko sign karne se pehle post-money aur asli stake chahiye.
Investor ek cheque aur stake bolta hai aur aapko us sentence ka implied pre-money chahiye, taaki pata chale kaunsa number asli me negotiate ho raha hai.
Wahi pre-money do alag cheques ke saath offer hota hai aur aapko dono ka dilution chahiye.
Aap cap table ka upar wala hissa bana rahe ho aur shareholders me baantne se pehle post-money total chahiye.
prepost.hi_intro: Term sheet me ₹90,00,000 pre-money aur ₹10,00,000 ka cheque likha hai. Dono numbers alag se ye nahi batate ki investor ka hissa kitna hoga; inhe jodo to post-money milta hai, aur stake usi total par naapa jaata hai.
prepost.hi_outro: ₹90,00,000 pre-money par ₹10,00,000 ka cheque ₹1,00,00,000 company banata hai aur 10% de deta hai. Pre-money jaga par rakho aur cheque badhao to stake bhi badhta hai; split hilta dekhne ke liye koi bhi field badlo.

propertyroi.what: Property ROI calculator us sawaal ka jawab deta hai jo doosra ghar kharidne wala aksar galat nikalta hai: is flat ne mujhe actually kitna kamaya? Do alag return hote hain aur dono confuse karna aasan hai. Ek cash hai - jo kiraya aapne liya. Doosra kagaz par - flat ki value kitni badhi. Sirf appreciation dekhkar property badi investment lagti hai, par cash mein kuch nahi mila ho sakta - aur tenant jaane ya EMI rukne par yahi maayne rakhta hai. Yeh calculator dono ek saath dikhata hai, un saalon ke hisaab se jitne aapne rakha.
propertyroi.formula: Total gain = (Sale Value − Purchase Price) + holding period ka kul kiraya. ROI = Total gain ÷ Purchase Price × 100, aur annualised figure isse saalon par baant deta hai. ₹60 lakh ka flat, 6 saal baad ₹85 lakh par becha, ₹1.2 lakh saalana kiraya: gain ₹25 lakh plus ₹7.2 lakh = ₹32.2 lakh, ₹60 lakh par - kul takreeban 54%, saalana takreeban 7.4%. Rental yield, matlab saalana kiraya ÷ purchase price, wahi number hai jise FD se compare karna chahiye.
when: Flat kiraye par hai aur jaan-na hai ki actually kitna return mil raha hai.
Doosri property aur FD ya debt fund ke beech choose karna hai.
Bechna hai aur price tay karne se pehle poora gain - cash aur appreciation dono - dekhna hai.
mistakes: Appreciation ginna aur kiraya bhool jaana, ya ulta. Return dono ko milaakar banta hai.
Jo paisa gaya woh bhool jaana - stamp duty, registration, brokerage, maintenance aur loan ka interest.
6% rental yield ko 7% FD se compare karna bina appreciation jode, jabki log property isi wajah se kharidte hain.

propertyvalue.what: Property valuation matlab aaj aapka flat, house ya plot kitne ka hai, iska estimate. Zyadatar ghar ke liye sabse seedha tareeka yahi hai: area jitna hai, usse locality ka actual per square foot rate multiply kar do. Banks, brokers aur buyers sab isi number se shuru karte hain. Asli bahas rate per square foot par hoti hai - 1,000 sq ft ka flat ek gali mein ₹80 lakh ka hai aur do kilometre door ₹1.6 crore ka, aur area wahi hai. Isliye yeh calculator sirf do numbers maangta hai.
propertyvalue.formula: Property Value = Area (sq ft) × Price per Sq Ft. 900 sq ft ka flat ₹7,500 per sq ft par ₹67.5 lakh. 1,400 sq ft ka flat ₹11,000 per sq ft par ₹1.54 crore. Ulta bhi kaam ka hai: agar broker 1,200 sq ft ke flat ka ₹1.2 crore maang raha hai, toh rate ₹10,000 per sq ft ban raha hai - ab isse aas-paas ke actual sold rates se compare kar lo. Yahi ek division overpriced listing pakad leti hai.
when: Flat dekh liya aur asking price ko locality ke per square foot rate se check karna hai.
Do localities compare kar rahe ho aur dono ko ek hi per-square-foot basis par laana hai.
Broker ne lump sum bola hai aur aap dekhna chahte ho ki usme rate per square foot kitna nikal raha hai.
mistakes: Built-up area use karna jab price carpet area par quote hui ho. Wahi flat carpet par 20% chhota lagta hai aur rate per square foot bina wajah zyada dikhta hai.
Asking rate ko market rate maan lena. Asking prices actual closing se upar hoti hain, kabhi 10% ya zyada.
Floor, building ki age aur facing ignore karna - ye ek hi building ke andar bhi rate badal dete hain.

rashi.what:
Rashi calculator ek hi sawaal tay karta hai: jab sirf birth date pata ho, to daily rashi forecast, panchang ya matching table kis moon sign ke liye likha gaya hai? Rashi wahi sign hai jo janm ke waqt chaand me tha, aur Vedic practice daily forecast isi se padhti hai, isliye ye tay karta hai ki barah forecast columns me kaunsa aapka hai. Tool Date of Birth leta hai aur approximate rashi deta hai, traditional order Mesha se Meena tak.

"Approximate" hi imaandaar baat hai, aur yahi is tool ko kundli se alag karta hai. Chaand har rashi me takreeban dhai din rehta hai, yaani lagbhag har 54 ghante me boundary cross karta hai; boundary ke ek din andar ki date dono taraf ja sakti hai, aur use sirf birth time settle karta hai. Tool mahine ki tareekh padhta hai, isliye rashi ke beech me sahi hai aur kinare par saaf taur par unsure - ise sahi forecast column chunne ke liye use karo, muhurat tay karne ke liye nahi.
rashi.formula: Chaand poora zodiac lagbhag 27.3 din me tay karta hai, yaani har rashi me takreeban 2.25 din. Tool aapki date se din (input dob) leta hai aur usse baari-baari Mesha, Vrishabha, Mithuna, Karka, Simha, Kanya, Tula, Vrishchika, Dhanu, Makara, Kumbha, Meena par map karta hai, aur us din ki rashi Approximate Rashi ke roop me deta hai. Yahan mahine ki tareekh chaand ki asli longitude ka stand-in hai, isliye jawab rashi ke beech me sahi rehta hai aur boundary ke paas ek rashi idhar-udhar ho sakta hai. Sahi rashi ke liye birth time aur place chahiye.
mistakes: Date-only rashi ko final maan lena. Boundary ke lagbhag ek din andar asli rashi ke liye birth time chahiye, aur estimate padosi rashi bata sakta hai.
Rashi aur Western sun sign ko ek samajhna. Dono me barah naam hain, par bhasha aur dates alag hain; Western sign sooraj se aata hai, chaand se nahi.
Date-only rashi se muhurat, shaadi ki date ya property kharid tay karna. Uske liye jyotish se poori kundli chahiye, day-of-month estimate nahi.
when: Aap daily rashi forecast ya panchang padh rahe ho aur jaanna hai ki barah columns me aapka kaunsa hai.
Birth date yaad hai par time nahi, aur sabse kareeb moon sign chahiye.
Dost ya partner ke saath rashi match kar rahe ho aur kisi ke paas birth record nahi hai.

rd.what:
RD Calculator batata hai ki ek fixed monthly deposit maturity tak kya banta hai. Aap har mahine same date par same amount daalte ho, bank har instalment par uske aane ke din se interest jodta hai, aur ant mein aapko poora deposited paisa plus har instalment ka kamaya interest milta hai. Tool Monthly Deposit, Annual Interest Rate aur Tenure (months) leta hai, aur Total Deposits, Maturity Amount aur Interest Earned teen alag figures deta hai - taaki aapko return dikhe, sirf ek headline maturity nahi.

RD deposit-side par SIP ka twin hai: same monthly discipline, ulta risk. Rate kholne ke din fix ho jaata hai, isliye Maturity Amount pehle se pata hota hai, par wahi certainty ceiling bhi hai - RD lamba horizon par ek accha equity fund nahi haraayega. Calculator ka asli kaam Interest Earned ko Total Deposits ke saath dikhana hai: ₹5,000 mahina 24 mahine par ₹1,29,154 ki maturity mein sirf ₹9,154 interest hai, aur yahi sahi measure hai ki bank aapko kitna de raha hai. Yahi split ek advertised 7% a year chhupa deta hai.
rd.formula: Har monthly instalment utne mahine interest kamata hai jitne wo account mein rehta hai, isliye pehli deposit sabse lamba compound karti hai aur aakhri sirf ek mahina. Tool a = rate / 1200 (monthly rate) aur n = months set karta hai, aur Maturity Amount = Monthly Deposit x ((1 + a)^n - 1) / a x (1 + a); Total Deposits = Monthly Deposit x n; Interest Earned = Maturity Amount - Total Deposits. ₹5,000 mahina, 7% aur 24 mahine par a = 0.005833 aur n = 24, factor 25.83, to Maturity Amount = ₹1,29,154, Total Deposits = ₹1,20,000 aur Interest Earned = ₹9,154. Ant mein (1 + a) ka matlab hai calculator har instalment ko uske mahine ke shuru mein credit karta hai, isliye figure banks ke quote ke generous end par baithta hai.
when: RD kholne wale ho aur commit karne se pehle exact maturity aur interest jaanna chahte ho, bank app ka approximately figure nahi.
Do-teen saal door ke goal ke liye RD ko debt mutual fund ya short-term FD se compare kar rahe ho, aur guaranteed number ko fund ke indicative number se tolna chahte ho.
Dekhna chahte ho ki Tenure badhane par interest kaise badalta hai - same Monthly Deposit 24 ke bajaye 36 mahine - taaki extra lock-in ka faayda judge kar sako.
mistakes: Annual Interest Rate ko poore balance par poore term ke liye apply hone ka maan lena. Sirf shuruaati instalments poora Tenure kamate hain; aakhri wale ek mahina, isliye Interest Earned Maturity Amount ka chhota hissa hai.

RD ke Maturity Amount ko lump-sum FD se compare karna, jabki RD poora balance sirf ant mein lock karta hai. RD average par kaafi kam capital bandhta hai, isliye uska effective yield raw interest figure se zyada hai.

RD ko das saal ke goal ke liye plan karna. Rate fixed aur modest hai, isliye lambe horizon par compounding equity certainty jo chhodti hai usse zyada return de deti hai; calculator ko short-term goal ke liye use karo, retirement ke liye nahi.

rentalyield.what: Rental Yield Calculator property ke rent ko uski cost ka annual percentage bana deta hai. Monthly rent ko 12 se guna karke saal ka rent nikalo, usko purchase price se divide karo aur 100 se guna karo. 50,00,000 ka ghar 20,000 monthly rent par saal ka 2,40,000 kamata hai, matlab gross yield 4.8%. Yeh percentage hi kaam ki cheez hai: do alag price wali properties ko ek hi scale par laata hai, aur property ko FD ya bond se compare karne deta hai.
rentalyield.formula: Annual rent = monthly rent x 12. Gross rental yield = annual rent / property price x 100. Tool base me purchase price leta hai, isliye rent same rehne par bhi price badhne se yield girta hai. Yeh gross yield hai: maintenance, property tax aur khaali pade hafte isme se nahi ghate, isliye asli net yield hamesha kam hota hai.
when: Jab aap do flats, alag price par, ek hi scale se compare kar rahe ho.
Jab aap dekhna chahte ho ki itne paise par rental FD se better hai ya nahi.
Jab aap dekhna chahte ho ki rent thoda kam hone par yield kitna badalta hai.
mistakes: Gross yield ko apna final return samajhna — maintenance aur vacancy pehle ghate hain.
Rent ko property price ke bajaye loan amount se divide karna.
Furnished flat ka yield bare shell se compare karna, price adjust kiye bina.

rentbuy.what: Rent vs Buy ek tay saal ke rent ko usi ghar ko khareedne ki cost se milata hai, loan ke bina. Rent side simple hai: monthly rent ko 12 se, phir compare karne wale saalon se guna karo. Buy side me home price plus ek baar ka upfront cost aata hai — stamp duty, registration, brokerage, shifting ka kharcha, jo wapas nahi aata. Tool home loan model nahi karta, isliye yeh chhota sawaal dekhta hai ki cash dene par kaunsi side chhoti padti hai.
rentbuy.formula: Total rent = monthly rent x 12 x years compared. Buy cost before loan = home price + upfront buy costs. Tool dono dikhata hai aur jo chhota ho usko lower cost kehta hai. EMI aur interest jaan-boojh kar chhod diye jaate hain, isliye buy figure day-one ka cash hai, poora holding cost nahi.
when: Jab aap rent par ho aur cash se khareedne ka break-even dekhna chahte ho.
Jab aapko purchase ka one-time cost chahiye, loan se alag.
Jab aap kisi ko samjha rahe ho ki kam rent bhi paanch saal me haar sakta hai.
mistakes: Buy figure ko poora ownership cost samajhna — loan interest usme nahi hai.
Paanch saal ka rent total ek ghar ki price se compare karna jise aap bees saal rakhoge.
Bhool jaana ki stamp duty aur registration upfront number me hain, price me nahi.

retention.what: Retention matlab kitne customers wapas aate hain; churn matlab kitne chhod dete hain. Dono milkar tay karte hain growth compound karegi ya leak karegi. Mahine ki shuruaat 1,000 customers se, aakhir bhi 1,000, aur beech me 100 naye aaye - matlab 100 purane gaye: retention 90%, churn 10%. Business har mahine customers jodta reh sakta hai aur phir bhi sikud sakta hai agar churn acquisition se zyada ho. Ye calculator dono dikhata hai, taaki leak bucket khaali hone se pehle dikh jaaye.
retention.formula: Retention % = (Customers at End − New Customers) ÷ Customers at Start × 100; Churn % = 100 − Retention %. 1,000 se shuru, 1,000 pe khatam, 100 naye: retained = 1,000 − 100 = 900, toh retention 90% aur churn 10%. Yahi ghatana zyadatar founders chhod dete hain - naye customers purane jaane ko chhupa dete hain, aur sirf calculation sach dikhati hai.
when: Subscription ya repeat-purchase business healthy hai ya nahi, ye naap rahe ho.
Retention pe invest karein ya acquisition pe, ye tay kar rahe ho.
Churn badalne ka saal bhar ke growth pe asar dekhna hai.
mistakes: Naye customers ko retention ginna, jisse gaye hue chhup jaate hain.
Churn mahine ka naapkar business ko saal ke numbers pe judge karna, ya ulta.
Chhote churn ko harmless maan lena - 5% mahina matlab saal me aadhi se zyada base gayi.

revmul.what:
Revenue Multiple kisi bhi valuation ka sabse tez sawaal hai: business saal me jitni sales karta hai, uske har ek rupaye ke badle buyer kitne rupaye de raha hai? Isme sirf do figures chahiye, price aur saalana revenue, aur dono me koi accounting judgement nahi hota - isliye broker isi multiple ko sabse pehle batata hai aur founder ise ek minute me khud check kar leta hai. Jab business early ho, profitable na ho, ya itni tez badh raha ho ki profit jaan-boojh kar growth par kharch ho raha ho, to revenue hi ek aisa figure hota hai jispe dono taraf bharosa karti hain, aur yahi multiple bacha hua ek price language hota hai.

Ye ek yardstick hai, verdict nahi. Revenue ye nahi batata ki sales profitable hain, recurring hain ya one-off, isliye ye number sirf margin ke saath hi matlab rakhta hai. Do business dono 3x revenue par chal sakti hain, phir bhi ek price ke laayak hai aur doosri nahi, kyunki pehli har rupaye ka 30% profit me badalti hai aur doosri 5%. Multiple se price ko ek range me rakho, phir margin aur growth se tay karo ki business us range me kahan deserve karti hai.
revmul.formula: Tool aapki daali valuation ko daale hue saalana revenue se divide karta hai aur jawab times me dikhata hai. Calculator ke variables me ye val divided by rev hai: 4,50,000 ki valuation 1,80,000 ke saalana revenue par 2.50x deti hai. 3x ka matlab hai buyer saalana bikri ke har rupaye par teen rupaye de raha hai. Profitable business ke liye ye do multiples me se hamesha chhota hota hai - revenue EBITDA se bada hota hai, isliye usse divide karne par multiple chhota aata hai - aur revenue aur EBITDA multiples ka gap hi profit margin hota hai. Dono ko saath rakho aur margin khud nikal aata hai.
mistakes: Recurring aur one-off revenue mila dena.
